name: MayAir Technology (China) Co., Ltd.
summary: MayAir Technology (China) Co., Ltd. engages in the research and development, production, and sale of medical air purification and atmospheric environment treatment equipment in China and internationally. The company's products include fan filter units; media, chemical, functional, electrostatic, and cartridge filters; and bio-safety sterile purification equipment, home and commercial air purifiers, medical disinfection machines and purification equipment, dust and oil mist removal equipment, kitchen oil fume equipment, and kitchen exhaust systems.
